intro: Wuhan is three cities around the junction of the Yangtze and the Han, and the rivers make it the busiest inland waterway in China. Ocean-going vessels reach here from the sea, more than six hundred miles upstream, so the marine band carries genuine deep-water shipping a very long way inland. It is also the rail crossroads of the country — the north-south and east-west trunk routes cross here — and the flat lake country around it gives VHF an easy time in every direction.
introz: 武汉是环绕长江与汉江交汇处的三座城，而河流让它成为中国最繁忙的内河航道。远洋船只能从入海口上溯一千公里到达这里，所以海事频段在深居内陆的地方仍承载着真正的远洋航运。它同时也是全国的铁路十字路口——南北与东西干线在此交汇；周围平坦的湖沼地形让 VHF 在各个方向都畅通无阻。
